review.question: TP-892 (Retire two old review steps) is done except that the old workflow's instructions still describe the Final verification step. TP-891 (Remove the retired review states) deletes those instructions anyway. Should TP-892 update them now, or leave them to TP-891?
review.recommendation_reason: TP-891 removes these instructions this week, so updating them twice adds work without changing what you see.
review.title: Update the old workflow's instructions now, or leave them to TP-891?
review.unblocks: TP-893, the app's view of the new review steps
review.why:
Code Review sent #448 back twice. Both times its only finding was that the old instructions still describe Final verification.

TP-880 already removed the Supervisor check. TP-891 removes the rest of the old review states, with these instructions, this week.
